race.title: BAR 1 Betting 'Safer Gambling Week' Rated Race
race.verdict: CITY HOUSE arrives after several good efforts at this track and looks the pick of the weights on this occasion. Alissam emerged with credit despite pulling hard over 1m here last time and is also considered back in trip, with Celtic Motif taken to round out the 1-2-3. CITY HOUSE (IRE) ALISSAM (IRE) CELTIC MOTIF (IRE)
